status.summary: Ranked featherweight knockout artist from Albuquerque (Jackson-Wink), pro record 19-6 (UFC 8-3). His seven-fight win streak ended when Diego Lopes knocked him out at 2:42 of round 2 at UFC Freedom 250 on the White House South Lawn (Jun 14, 2026). Garcia had won round 1 and buckled Lopes early in round 2. He is booked against former interim champion Yair Rodriguez at UFC 335 (Dec 12, 2026, T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas); Garcia confirmed the bout on Instagram.
status.ranking: #14 featherweight (UFC, as cited by MMA Mania, Oct-Nov 2026)
status.next_fight: vs Yair Rodriguez, UFC 335, Dec 12, 2026, T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas

signature: southpaw straight left (buckled Diego Lopes early in round 2 at UFC Freedom 250)
forward pressure with low kicks to back opponents onto the fence (round 1 vs Lopes)
punches to the body (KO of Shayilan Nuerdanbieke with a body punch, 2023; 23/29 body strikes vs Calvin Kattar)
ground strikes and elbows to finish (Costa from mount, Kyle Nelson from half guard, Onama on the ground)
weaknesses: chin: 6 knockdowns absorbed and 2 KO losses in 11 UFC fights (Maheshate 2022, Diego Lopes 2026)
gets drawn into exchanges of hooks; Lopes's finishing sequence came out of a hook exchange
little takedown offense of his own (no landed takedowns since 2021 in the UFC)
weight-making was a recurring problem earlier in his career (Albuquerque Journal, 2020)
style.summary: A tall (6 ft 0 in, 75 in reach) southpaw featherweight who comes forward fast and throws in volume, mostly at the head. His straight left and follow-up ground strikes finished six of his seven streak wins. The cost is defense: he has been knocked down six times in the UFC, and the Lopes loss came in an exchange he had been winning.

moves.notes: Southpaw: 'cross' means his straight left, the punch match reports single out vs Lopes. Weights follow his target split in fighters.json. Decayed significant attempts go 85.3% head, 9.0% body, 5.7% legs (featherweight league 76/14/10); landed strikes go 72.8% head, 15.5% body, 11.7% legs. Head punches carry most of the weight. Body shots are mostly punches (23/29 body strikes vs Kattar; body-punch KO of Nuerdanbieke), so body hooks and straights outweigh body kicks. Leg kicks are low but present (11/11 leg strikes vs Lopes; low kicks noted in round 1 of that fight). Elbows get 0.25 because two finishes were ground elbows (Costa, Nelson) and 17% of his decayed landed strikes come on the ground. No head-kick or spinning finishes are recorded. Sources: ufcstats sums and per-fight totals; middleeasy and mmamania recaps of UFC Freedom 250.

appearance.build: tall and long for featherweight; 6 ft 0 in with a 75 in reach (ufcstats)

engine_notes.note: Chin concern: 6 knockdowns absorbed in 68 UFC minutes; 5.45 KD per 100 significant head strikes absorbed career, 4.15 decayed, against a featherweight league rate of 0.94.
Power: 3.15 KD per 100 significant head strikes landed career (league 0.94); 7 of 8 UFC wins by KO/TKO.
Very high output: 10.6 significant attempts per minute career and 13.3 decayed. The Kattar decision alone was 250 attempts in 15 minutes.
Fast starter: 7 of his 8 UFC wins ended inside two rounds, four of them in round 1. His only five-round booking (Onama) ended at 3:34 of round 1, so there is no late-round data.

He rarely shoots (0.74 takedown attempts per 15 min decayed) but defends well: decayed takedown defense 81% (league 62%). Opponents control him 174 s per 15 min decayed, close to the 169 s league rate.
